note: Focused source-shaped runtime tests cover known-leader immediate resend, nil-leader scheduling before deferred invalidation, terminal/unsupported close, exact route validation, and one per-region budget shared with the outer rebuild. They also prove cancellation during sleep prevents invalidation, PD reload, and redispatch. Locks, generic connection retry, store limits, async paths, forwarding, TLS, and production RPC failover remain open.
